description: Add a comment or threaded reply to a document. Provide target_paragraph_id + anchor_text for root comments, or parent_comment_id for replies. Supports DOCX and ODT (ODT backs comments with office:annotation; threaded replies are DOCX-only). Surface: revisionable + package-mutation — the body-story comment reference is tracked (w:ins), while comment text and author metadata are recorded in the save report non-revision change manifest.

anchor_text.description: Text within the paragraph to anchor the comment to. If omitted, anchors to entire paragraph.

file_path.description: Path to the DOCX or ODT file.

initials.description: Author initials (defaults to first letter of author name).

parent_comment_id.description: Parent comment ID for threaded replies.

target_paragraph_id.description: Paragraph ID to anchor the comment to (for root comments).

name: add_comment
